scientific_limitations: Finite connected complete multipartite starting graphs only; fractional exponent strictly between zero and one; scaling beta at least one.

Mathematical historical priority is not independently certified.
title: A sharp maximum-principle phase boundary for Heun diffusion on scaled fractional-regularized multipartite graphs
